label: An amniote life-history database to perform comparative analyses with birds, mammals, and reptiles (Aug 2015 release)
bibliographic_citation: Myhrvold NP, Baldridge E, Chan B, Sivam D, Freeman DL, Ernest SKM (2015) An amniote life-history database to perform comparative analyses with birds, mammals, and reptiles. Ecology 96:3109. Ecological Archives E096-269.
license: Ecological Archives data paper; reuse with citation
measurement_technique: Literature-compiled life-history trait values (29 traits) for 21,322 amniote species; missing values coded -999.
role: life-history traits (body mass, longevity, maturity, clutch/litter) for the listed birds and mammals

integrity.note: sha256 computed on the downloaded file; publisher offers no checksum
